ticker_news.title: What Is One of the Best Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks to Hold for the Next 5 Years?
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies is highlighted as a promising AI stock with significant growth potential, experiencing accelerating demand for its AI platforms and expanding its addressable market across industries.
ticker_news.author: John Ballard

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Beat Earnings, but Investors Are Asking the Wrong Question. Here's the Right One.
ticker_news.description: Nvidia reported strong Q3 earnings with $57 billion revenue, up 62% year-over-year, dismissing AI bubble concerns. The company suggests focusing on AI software companies like OpenAI and Anthropic to assess the AI boom's strength.
ticker_news.author: Jeremy Bowman

QQQ.title: A December Rate Cut Coming? Goldman Tells Investors To Buy The Dip
QQQ.description: Goldman Sachs predicts a potential December rate cut by the Federal Reserve, citing weakening labor market conditions and potential economic easing in 2026. The firm advises investors to buy market dips and remain overweight in equities.
QQQ.author: Piero Cingari
